status: proposed implementation observation convention; no observed backend behavior or gate approval
boundary: Existing condition_ref, payload.expression, result file and timeout_seconds/output_bytes only. Artifact members below describe producer diagnostics, not new public operation/schema/request fields or private worker functions. Distinct bundle/API review must accept this convention before freeze; incompatibility returns for review, never silent contract amendment.
condition_ref: An absolute pathname to a regular UTF-8 diagnostic artifact within that session's private diagnostics directory, keyed by the correlated operation_id; resolve directly, never relative to caller cwd. Publish before the terminal operation refers to it. No symlink/parent escape or overwrite of another operation's diagnostics.

diagnostic_object.condition: Object with type:string, text:string, fallback:boolean. Type is the captured condition identity; text is bounded trusted rendering or minimal identity fallback, never a fabricated successful report.
diagnostic_object.backtrace: Array of {index:integer, frame:string} from actual active pre-unwind frames in stack order. Only this section establishes frame observations; condition text/source echoes cannot stand in for it.
diagnostic_object.restarts: Array of {name:string|null, description:string} from actual compute-restarts before unwind; use bounded trusted name/description fallback rather than executing arbitrary restart report callbacks. Descriptions are not invocable objects.
diagnostic_object.truncated: Boolean true when any diagnostic material is omitted by depth/length/byte limits.
diagnostic_object.capture_failed: Boolean true when capture/rendering cannot complete safely; false does not imply untruncated capture. An empty array after failure is not proof of no frames/restarts.

encoding: Normal artifact is one JSON object with exactly the five diagnostic_object members, no trailing newline required. Existing operation condition_capture=before_unwind identifies capture timing; tests independently prove dynamic context. Do not infer actual frames/restarts from marker strings alone.
tiny_budget: If a truthful structured object cannot fit, artifact is exactly the single ASCII byte 0 (JSON number zero), meaning omitted/truncated diagnostics and unavailable full capture. This explicit minimal fallback fits every valid output_bytes>=1, carries no frame/restart proof and must not be mistaken for a successful full capture. Never exceed the requested budget to append metadata or a truncation message.
scalar_result: For normal SBCL completion, existing operations/<operation_id>.result.json member result is JSON number 42 for arithmetic42 and an exact JSON string for the fresh nonce. Existing poll result remains the operation record; result file supplies the value with its correlated operation/generation/status. No extra public result field. A scalar that cannot fit its rendering budget must not become a falsely completed altered value.
stricter_limits: Rendered diagnostic artifact, project result rendering and captured project stdout/stderr share B=min(16384, operation limits.output_bytes if supplied). Diagnostic wall budget is min(0.25, operation limits.timeout_seconds if supplied); cancel-confirmation deadline is min(1.0, that operation limit if supplied), including zero. These are internal bounds, no new limit keys. Protocol identity/status framing is not project rendering; all emitted diagnostic artifacts including fallback bytes count toward B.
budget_exhaustion: Reserve one byte of B for omission diagnostics when condition capture needs fallback; do not let prior project output consume it then write extra bytes. Bound buffers before encoding/emission. If prior rendering prevents safe truthful scalar completion, retain honest failure/uncertainty rather than emit a truncated success value. Header/framing is never a route for unbounded project-controlled text.
hostile_printers: Project condition-report/print-object/restart-report callbacks are not needed for trusted minimal fallback and must not defeat byte/time limits. Bound depth/length/circle in worker bindings; no recursive unsafe fallback. A stuck capture remains outstanding execution until actual stop/observed process death; no invented diagnostics or completion.
cancel_timing: Measure confirmation deadline monotonically from durable cancel_requested; acknowledge cancelled only after correlated worker unwind/cleanup has finished. Deadline expiry initiates owned runtime-group TERM, then KILL after at most0.25s, with at most1.0s further death observation. Until death is observed retain unknown/busy uncertainty, never report terminated from signal delivery alone. No poll wait timeout implicitly cancels work.
review_and_evidence: Evaluator owns assertions/fixtures and distinct reviewer owns bundle/API acceptance. All actual commands/exits/source identities, admitted baseline red, activation/allocation, Source release, PR105 delivery gates, ModeB, freshQA+exactlyone extra and Root capture remain required. This file supplies no run, Source scaffold, acceptance proof, lifecycle change or new budget; count preparation once within existing129/020 process.
